title: Height-Balanced Search Invariants for the Traveling Salesman Problem: A Chronos-Topology Implementation of Genetic and Held-Karp Hybrid
topic: The Traveling Salesman Problem: From 19th Century Puzzles to Genetic Algorithms
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: The Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) remains a canonical benchmark for combinatorial optimization. We present a Chronos-Topology-based hybrid that couples a height-balanced search tree for state indexing with a genetic algorithm for tour refinement. The Held-Karp dynamic program is embedded within the tree to maintain a minimal-cost invariant for every visited subset, while the genetic component explores the solution space beyond the exponential frontier. Formal invariants guarantee that the tree remains strictly height-balanced and that each node preserves the key-ordered property, yielding an asymptotic search complexity of $O(\log N)$ for insertions and queries. The implementation is fully reproducible; source code is available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Topology-concurrency-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261119_080140_the_traveling_salesman_problem}.
